map.算例：年入库沙量 20 万 t、淤积物干容重 1.35 t/m³（总库容 100: Example: annual sediment inflow 200k t, deposit dry density 1.35 t/m³ (total capacity 10 million m³)
map.年淤积体积 = 20 ÷ 1.35 = 14.81 万 m³；50 年累计淤积: Annual deposition = 20 ÷ 1.35 = 14.81 (10k m³); 50-year cumulative = 14.81 × 50 = 740.74 (10k m³); storage-loss rate = 740.74 ÷ 1000 × 100% = 74.07%; annual loss rate = 1.48%.

map.水库泥沙淤积库容损失（本页代码口径）：年淤积体积=Ws÷γ（万 m³，Ws 年入: Reservoir sedimentation storage loss (as implemented on this page): annual deposition volume = Ws÷γ (10k m³; Ws annual sediment inflow in 10k t, γ deposit dry density in t/m³); cumulative deposition = annual deposition × years (10k m³; years = assessment period); storage loss rate = cumulative÷V×100% (V total capacity in 10k m³); annual average loss rate = annual÷V×100%; years to fill = V÷annual deposition (years); remaining effective capacity = max(V−cumulative, 0) (10k m³).
